informal: The Lean does not use fingerprints: it compares full endpoint IDs exactly with a catalytic test that adds \(\sum_i(x_i-y_i)^2\) modulo \(M\) to a shared register, reads the result in four bit tests, and restores the register.

results.informal: Four endpoint excursions change a shared catalytic register exactly when \(x\ne y\), four inverse excursions restore it, and a program built on this branches on \(x=y\).
results.note: CatalyticComparison carries out the restoring four-excursion equality test of this lemma, but on the exact IDs \(x,y\) rather than on hashed keys \(k(v),k(w)\).

decls.name: test_eye
decls.informal: For IDs \(x,y\le \text{peak}\) and a proper catalytic register \(V=(V_1,V_2,V_3)\), the four-step transform \(\mathrm{fair}_{x,y}\) leaves the middle component unchanged if and only if \(x=y\): \(\mathrm{fair}_{x,y}(V)_2=V_2\iff x=y\).

chunks.CatalyticComparison.test_eye/0: The transform adds \(h(x,y)=\sum_{i<L}(x_i-y_i)^2\) modulo \(M\) to \(V_2\) and leaves \(V_1,V_3\) unchanged.
chunks.CatalyticComparison.test_eye/3/0: Assume the middle component is unchanged.
chunks.CatalyticComparison.test_eye/3/2: Since \(0\le h(x,y)<M\), this forces \(h(x,y)=0\), and \(h(x,y)=0\) holds exactly when \(x=y\).

decls.name: back
decls.informal: For a proper register \(V\), the inverse sequence of four excursions restores it: \(\mathrm{dark}_{x,y}(\mathrm{fair}_{x,y}(V))=V\).

chunks.CatalyticComparison.back/0: Name the intermediate registers \(a,b,c\) after the first three excursions of \(\mathrm{fair}_{x,y}\).
chunks.CatalyticComparison.back/4: The fourth excursion is undone by its inverse, returning \(c\).
chunks.CatalyticComparison.back/7: The first inverse excursion returns \(V\), so \(\mathrm{dark}_{x,y}(\mathrm{fair}_{x,y}(V))=V\).

decls.name: done0
decls.informal: If the endpoint excursions behave as specified and \(x,y\le\text{peak}\), then the comparison program built from four bit tests runs from the proper register \(V\) to the continuation of branch \(\text{yes}\) when \(x=y\) and of branch \(\text{no}\) when \(x\ne y\).

chunks.CatalyticComparison.done0/0: We have \(x=y\) if and only if, for all \(i<4\), flipping the bit of \(V_3\) indexed by the \(i\)-th base-\(n\) digit of \(V_2\) changes the probed bit after the transform.
chunks.CatalyticComparison.done0/1: Run the four bit-test blocks and choose the yes branch when all four tests succeed and the no branch otherwise.

unmapped.reason: The Lean compares exact endpoint IDs catalytically and never builds a short hash map \(k\).
There is no salted fingerprint or clean calculation in the Lean, since IDs are compared exactly.
Collisions of keys do not arise in the Lean, so the envelope and its collision bound are not formalized.
The actual-clean coupling for escaped candidates is not formalized because the Lean has no fingerprints.
The Lean has no bucket aliasing of increments, since it compresses with exact IDs.
There are no collisions in the Lean, so no direct collision cost is stated.
The actual-clean block coupling is unnecessary in the Lean, which uses exact-ID comparisons.
The final estimator error bounds are proved in the Lean's hierarchical estimator induction rather than as a fingerprint-section theorem, and no single declaration matches this statement.
